seed: Generated once by the pinned conductor from the run ID; retained in run.json and shared across both arms.
probeTimeout: The public conductor uses timeLimitSeconds for probes when explicitly supplied: 1200 seconds per invocation.
probeGate: All six arm/member probes and all three judge probes must pass before any scored reader invocation. No reduced population is accepted.
limits: Provider limit fields are declared configuration, not measurements of backend capacity. No outputTokenMax setting or model substitution is added.
authority: Director selected the provider amendment, independent readiness recheck and conditional whole-comparison execution; no runtime implementation, ratification, publication or B53 closure.
